title: The Rainy Picnic
summary: Ama and her friend Tom plan a picnic in the park, but the rain comes and they find a fun new plan.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama sitting under a big umbrella on a picnic blanket in a green park, light rain, no text

chapters.title: A Sunny Plan
sentences: On Friday evening, Ama looked at the weather on her phone.
The next day was going to be warm and sunny.
"Let us have a picnic in the park," she told her friend Tom.
Tom loved the idea.
He wanted to bring sandwiches and juice.
Ama said she would make a big salad and bring a blanket.
They agreed to meet at the park gate at twelve.
That night, Ama was very happy and went to bed early.

quiz.q: What did Ama check on her phone?
quiz.explain: Ama looked at the weather on her phone.
He wanted to bring sandwiches and juice.
They agreed to meet at the park gate at twelve.

chapters.title: Here Comes the Rain
sentences: On Saturday, Ama woke up and heard a strange noise.
It was raining hard outside.
She called Tom at once.
"The weather report was wrong," he said with a laugh.
"Maybe we can wait a little," Ama said.
They waited for an hour, but the rain did not stop.
Ama put the salad and the blanket in a bag anyway.
Then she took her umbrella and walked to the park.

quiz.q: What did Ama hear when she woke up?
quiz.explain: Ama woke up and heard a strange noise.
They waited for an hour, but the rain did not stop.

quiz.q: What did Ama take to the park?
quiz.explain: She put the salad and the blanket in a bag, then took her umbrella.

chapters.title: Lunch Under the Roof
sentences: At the park, Tom was waiting under a small roof near the lake.
He was wet, but he was smiling.
"This is our new picnic place," he said.
Ama opened the blanket on the dry floor.
They ate sandwiches and salad while the rain made soft music on the roof.
A little girl came and sat next to them.
She had no lunch, so they shared their food with her.
It was the best picnic of the year.

quiz.explain: Tom was waiting under a small roof near the lake.
A little girl came and sat next to them.

quiz.q: Why did they share their food?
quiz.explain: She had no lunch, so they shared their food with her.
